steps.description: The hands unscrew the rear thumbscrew and slide the black side panel off to expose the interior.
steps.title: Remove the side panel

steps.description: The hands insert the small round CMOS battery into its socket on the motherboard.
steps.title: Install the coin cell battery

steps.description: The hands seat the green RAM modules into the blue memory slots and press the clips closed.
steps.title: Install the RAM sticks

steps.description: The hands plug the red data lead and power leads into the hard disk drive in the front bay.
steps.title: Connect the hard disk drive

steps.description: The hands route the PSU leads and seat the system power connectors onto the motherboard.
steps.title: Connect system power to motherboard

steps.description: The hands plug the rear cooling fan lead into its motherboard fan header.
steps.title: Connect the cooling fan cable

steps.description: The hands wipe the inside of the open chassis with the blue cleaning cloth.
steps.title: Clean the interior with cloth

steps.description: The hands fit the side panel back onto the chassis and retighten the rear thumbscrew.
steps.title: Replace the side panel

steps.description: The hands connect mains and display cables and power on the PC to verify the boot screen.
steps.title: Connect power and test boot

task_summary: Open the PC, install battery and RAM, connect HDD, power and fan, clean, close case and test boot.
